description: Erection of a part single storey side extension incoporating front porch and associated internal alterations. Extension of first floor rear roof terrace.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed enlargement to the rear roof terrace would, owing to its bulky and incongruous design and the loss of an important design feature of the original Grade II Listed building, appear bulky and incongruous thereby causing harm to the character and appearance of the Listed Building and wider Bedford Park Conservation Area. The application is therefore contrary to Local Plan policies CC1, CC2, CC4 and SC7 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines SPD and Bedford Park Conservation Area Appraisal.

Condition : 2 - The proposed internal works due to the excessive loss of historic fabric would be detrimental to the character and appearance of the Listed Buildings. The application is therefore contrary to Local Plan policies CC1, CC2, CC4 and SC7 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines SPD and Bedford Park Conservation Area Appraisal.

Condition : 3 - The proposed relocation of the entrance door would be harm the design and layout of the Listed Building. The application is therefore contrary to Local Plan policies CC1, CC2, CC4 and SC7 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines SPD and Bedford Park Conservation Area Appraisal.
